accuracy_main.cause: Native AST CompiledKernel launcher needs the original runtime + constexpr bindings; the reused TTIR launcher omitted those bindings, causing Python SystemError before valid source-route launch. The process later stalled in a bad launch and was explicitly terminated.

pipeline_main.cause: Same AST launcher binding error; source-to-TTIR byte-equality assertions had already passed for the attempted group, output comparison could not run.

pipeline_main_v2.cause: Compiler metadata normalizes some nested option tuples to lists; literal Python equality was too strict. JSON-normalized comparison of every full option field is used in v3. No compiler options changed.

accuracy_main_v2.cause: Launcher corrected and all numeric checks passed, but previous failed validation process was still resident. Excluded and repeated in isolation; no performance taken.

original_contract: All runs use exactly the existing 28 input cases, distributions, FP64 reference, rtol=0.03/atol=0.008; no tolerance changes and no case removals.
